verdict.rationale: Notte documents Functions, which deploy browser automations as serverless API endpoints that can be invoked and scheduled anywhere (notte-docs-2, notte-docs-26). These run in isolated cloud browser sessions (notte-docs-24) with web agents that act on the user's behalf (notte-docs-37), so automations can run autonomously in the background without a local machine. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of scheduling and trigger configuration (the evidence is one-line claims and a truncated functions page), background run monitoring and alerting, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work reliably.
